# Story 01 — Knowledge Base (bilingual articles, search, ticket integration)

## Prerequisites

- `customers` feature shipped: reuses `Attachment` + `IFileStorage` for article media/PDF uploads. Coordinate with the owner if attachment endpoints change signature.
- `tickets` feature shipped: this story hooks a KB search + insert-link affordance into the ticket reply composer.
- Sibling features `customer-portal` and `ai-features` **consume** the read APIs shipped here — publish the DTOs and controller routes named in this plan before those teams take a dependency.
- No prior KB story exists; this is greenfield inside the established solution.

---

## Story Goal

Deliver a bilingual (ar/en) knowledge base that both agents (from a ticket) and, later, customers (from the portal) can search and read. Concretely:

1. An `Article` aggregate with bilingual title/body, per-language slug, category, tags, draft/published/archived state, author, view count, votes, versions, and soft-delete.
2. A category tree modelled the same way as `TicketCategory`, plus an `IsFaq` flag on articles so FAQs can be listed independently.
3. Ranked full-text search across Arabic and English with a normalisation helper (alef/hamza/diacritics), returning highlighted excerpts.
4. HTML sanitisation on write with an allow-list, so stored bodies cannot execute script when rendered by any channel.
5. Append-only versioning: every save writes an `ArticleVersion` row; editors can view and diff previous versions.
6. Voting (helpful / not-helpful) that is idempotent per reader (staff user id, or anonymous reader fingerprint), plus view counters.
7. Ticket linkage: when an agent inserts an article link into a reply, an `ArticleTicketLink` row is written so the desk can see which articles resolve tickets.
8. Authorization: only Admin/Manager and the author see drafts; only published articles are exposed to non-staff (`[AllowAnonymous]` read endpoints for the portal).
9. Frontend admin screens (list/create/edit/versions) + agent-side KB search panel embedded in the ticket detail reply flow. Full RTL, 375px responsive, all strings under `nav.knowledgeBase` and new keys in both `locales/ar.json` / `locales/en.json`.

**Not in scope:** AI draft generation (see `ai-features`), the customer portal shell (see `customer-portal`), automated translation of article content.

## Product rules (from story)

- Non-staff readers see **published** articles only. Drafts are visible to their author, Admin, and Manager. Archived articles are hidden from listings but reachable by permalink for editors.
- Slugs are unique **per language** (`slug_ar` unique, `slug_en` unique) and MUST NOT change once the article has been published at least once. Editing the localised title after publish updates the display title but keeps the frozen slug.
- Rich body content is sanitised **on save** with a shared allow-list (tags: `p, br, strong, em, u, ol, ul, li, a[href|title|rel], h2, h3, h4, blockquote, code, pre, img[src|alt|title], table, thead, tbody, tr, th, td`; no `script`, `style`, `iframe`, `on*`, `javascript:` URLs). Sanitisation MUST also run on read as a defence-in-depth pass.
- Search normalises both the index text and the query: strip Arabic diacritics (Tashkeel `U+064B–U+065F`, `U+0670`), fold alef variants `أإآ → ا`, fold `ى → ي`, fold `ة → ه`, and lowercase Latin.
- Vote idempotency: a `(articleId, voterKey)` unique index enforces one vote per reader. `voterKey` is the current user id for authenticated calls, or a signed anonymous reader token (opaque string) for portal calls.
- Versioning: every successful update writes an `ArticleVersion` (append-only). Deleting the latest version is not supported; rollback creates a new version from an old snapshot.

- `ArticleService.cs` — implements the interface. Key rules:
  - On `CreateAsync`: sanitise `BodyAr`/`BodyEn` via `IHtmlSanitizer`, derive `SearchTextAr`/`SearchTextEn` via `ArabicTextNormalizer.BuildSearchText`, generate slugs when missing via `ArabicTextNormalizer.Slugify`, ensure per-language slug uniqueness (throw `ConflictException`).
  - On `UpdateAsync`: snapshot the pre-update state into `ArticleVersion` **before** applying changes; refuse to change slugs if `FirstPublishedAt != null` (throw `BadRequestException`).

    - Prefer SQL Server `CONTAINSTABLE(Articles, (SearchTextAr, SearchTextEn, TitleAr, TitleEn), @q)` joined by rank; project a highlighted excerpt built in C# by finding the first normalised match window in `SearchTextAr` or `SearchTextEn` and wrapping matched tokens in `<mark>…</mark>` (the excerpt is not stored HTML — it is generated per-response and sanitised).

    - Non-staff callers are forced to `IncludeDrafts = false` and `Status == Published`.

  - `RecordViewAsync`: increments `ViewCount` (a small race here is acceptable; use `ExecuteUpdateAsync` `x.ViewCount + 1` to avoid a read-modify-write).
  - `LinkToTicketAsync`: upserts an `ArticleTicketLink`; called by the ticket "insert article link" action so the backend records the linkage independently of the reply body.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Non-Arabic script in an Arabic body / Arabic script in an English body.** The normaliser must handle mixed-script content without crashing. Trigger: pasted Latin snippets in an Arabic article. Expected: both indexed correctly. Enforced in `ArabicTextNormalizer.BuildSearchText` and covered by the search test.
- **Very long HTML body (> 1 MB).** Trigger: pasted screenshots or large tables. Expected: sanitised, rejected only if exceeding `Article.BodyAr`/`BodyEn` max length. Enforced by `ArticleValidators`.
- **Malicious HTML (`<script>`, `onerror`, `javascript:` links, SVG `onload`).** Trigger: XSS attempt from an editor. Expected: stripped by `IHtmlSanitizer` on save; a second-pass sanitisation runs on read. Verified by a xUnit test asserting the persisted `Body*` does not contain `<script`.
- **Duplicate slug per language.** Trigger: two authors publishing the same title. Expected: 409 Conflict via `ConflictException`. Enforced by the unique filtered index and a pre-check in `ArticleService`.
- **Slug edit after publish.** Trigger: rename attempt on a published article. Expected: `BadRequestException("kb.slugFrozen")`. Enforced in `ArticleService.UpdateAsync`.
- **Concurrent votes from the same reader.** Trigger: double-click on the vote button. Expected: unique index on (`ArticleId`, `VoterKey`) prevents duplication; `VoteAsync` catches the `DbUpdateException` and treats it as idempotent.
- **Search with an empty or whitespace query.** Expected: returns the most recently published articles ordered by `PublishedAt DESC`, not an error.
- **Full-text catalog missing.** Trigger: dev SQL Server without FTS. Expected: migration skips FTS DDL; service uses the `LIKE` fallback. Covered by a switch in `ArticleService.SearchAsync`.
- **Anonymous vote without a `voterKey`.** Expected: 400 Bad Request; validator requires `VoterKey` when the caller is unauthenticated.
- **Draft leaked via search.** Trigger: portal caller passes `includeDrafts=true`. Expected: server ignores the flag for non-staff callers.
- **Rollback of a version to a state whose slug conflicts with another article.** Expected: 409 Conflict; do not silently mutate the slug.
- **Cross-department scoping.** Trigger: agent in Department A opens an article whose department is B. Expected: 404 via `NotFoundException` from the scoped query filter.
- **Category deletion with articles attached.** Trigger: admin deletes a non-empty category. Expected: 409 with `kb.categoryInUse`. Enforced in `ArticleCategoryService`.
- **Article view spam.** Not fully addressed in this story — noted here. Rate-limiting the public view endpoint is a follow-up; leave a TODO comment in the controller.

## Migration / Rollback

- New EF migration `KnowledgeBase` adds tables `ArticleCategories`, `Articles`, `ArticleTags`, `ArticleVersions`, `ArticleVotes`, `ArticleTicketLinks`, plus indexes and (conditionally) the full-text catalog + index.
- `Down()` drops the FTS index first, then the catalog, then the tables in reverse dependency order.
- **Half-applied risk:** if `Up()` fails after creating tables but before the FTS DDL, re-running the migration should be idempotent — wrap FTS creation in `IF NOT EXISTS` checks against `sys.fulltext_catalogs` and `sys.fulltext_indexes`.
- Rollback of a production deployment where articles have been created loses content — coordinate with the team before rolling back beyond `KnowledgeBase`.

---

## Verification Steps

1. **Backend builds:** `dotnet build backend/CustomerSupportCRM.slnx`.
2. **Add migration:** `dotnet ef migrations add KnowledgeBase --project backend/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Api --output-dir Persistence/Migrations`.
3. **Apply migration to dev DB:** `dotnet ef database update --project backend/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Api`.
4. **Backend tests:** `dotnet test backend/CustomerSupportCRM.slnx` — all existing tests plus the new KB tests pass.
5. **Frontend builds:** `npm run build --prefix frontend`.
6. **Frontend runs:** `npm run dev --prefix frontend` and manually walk: create → edit → publish → search (Arabic query with unnormalised diacritics) → open from ticket → insert link → vote → view versions → rollback.
7. **Regression:** smoke `TicketDetailView.vue` — reply composer still works with the new side panel absent (feature-flag path optional), ticket categories unaffected, `SlaAdminView` still loads.
8. **Security check:** POST an article body containing `<script>alert(1)</script>` and verify the persisted `BodyAr` in SQL does not contain `<script`.
9. **Anonymous access:** with no bearer token, `GET /api/kb/public/ar/<slug>` returns 200 for a published article and 404 for a draft.

## Done Criteria

- [ ] `Article` entity supports bilingual title/body, per-language slug, category, tags, draft/published/archived, and an author.
- [ ] Articles live in a category tree and `IsFaq` distinguishes FAQ entries so FAQs can be listed separately.
- [ ] Full-text (or documented `LIKE` fallback) search returns ranked results for Arabic and English, and an Arabic-query test proves it.
- [ ] Search results are ranked and the excerpt highlights the matched query via `<mark>`.
- [ ] Only published articles are visible to non-staff readers; drafts remain visible to their author and to Admin/Manager.
- [ ] From the ticket detail screen, an agent can search the KB and insert an article link into a reply; the linkage is stored server-side in `ArticleTicketLinks`.
- [ ] `ViewCount`, `HelpfulCount`, `NotHelpfulCount` update; the (`ArticleId`, `VoterKey`) unique index blocks repeat votes.
- [ ] `ArticleTicketLink` records every insert-to-reply action, and the article detail exposes the list of linked tickets to staff.
- [ ] Article edits produce append-only `ArticleVersion` rows; UI lets an editor view previous versions and roll back.
- [ ] Stored HTML is sanitised on save via `IHtmlSanitizer`, verified by a unit test that asserts `<script>` is stripped; render path also sanitises defensively.
- [ ] All new tables use soft delete, `AuditableEntity`, and the `AuditingInterceptor` (no manual audit stamping).
- [ ] `Permissions.KnowledgeBase.*` added; `[AllowAnonymous]` used only on the public read/vote/view endpoints; `FallbackPolicy` untouched.
- [ ] All new UI strings exist in both `locales/ar.json` and `locales/en.json`; screens render correctly RTL at 375px.
- [ ] `dotnet test backend/CustomerSupportCRM.slnx` and `npm run build --prefix frontend` both pass.

**STOP HERE. Report to the user and wait for confirmation before extending Knowledge Base with follow-up stories (rate-limiting, AI-suggested articles, portal shell integration).**
